Applies P5: sol gpt-6.2-sol, astra gpt-6.2-astra (ran via Paseo codex, ChatGPT account, 2026-11-25); haiku claude-haiku-5-5 (Paseo alias resolution). Adds LEVEL 2 Terra lateral (also changes Orca/codex output), failed_family/failed_models/implementer_family, cross_family_review, premium_requires_reason, paseo_profiles gains managed metadata (replaces paseo_roles). Fable 5-2 observed, not adopted. Haiku efforts changed from [] to low..max (so expect [haiku, high] now validates although effort support is not verified); hosts.paseo.default_mode_id added. P6 not applied.

Add host paseo (P1), Paseo-host Sonnet high orchestrator/coordinator roles with no fallback and an orchestrator_tools restriction (P2), paseo_profiles name map (P3) and review_mode (P4). Orca, claude and codex host values, orca_task_routes and limits are unchanged. P5 (Codex fallback IDs) and P6 (profile plan_mode in the user Paseo config) are not applied; verified_on is not refreshed because model access was not re-verified.

notes: Codex Luna/Terra/Sol/Astra resolve to the highest visible, API-supported generation in the installed models_cache.json matching codex_family when fetched within 30 days; the family resolver also supports Terra for project-specific routes. id is the last-known fallback when the cache is missing, stale, or has no match. The resolver reads but never refreshes that cache. Claude and Fable IDs remain version-pinned. Prices are intentionally null until an approved source is recorded; null means the cost estimate is reported as not collected.

orca.description: Confirmed Orca task: Controller may assign either tool per worker.

paseo.description: Confirmed Paseo task: orchestrators need Paseo tools (Claude only); workers may be Claude or Codex. Output is a create_agent starting configuration; the Owner computes attempts, escalation and concurrency.

2.name: general
2.lateral_note: After one counted failure at LEVEL 2 the standard-tier lateral model gets the second and last LEVEL 2 attempt; fallbacks are off for this step. Never a premium model.

5.name: last_resort
5.note: Reached only by escalation after LEVEL 4 fails twice on the same root problem. Never a starting level.

cross_family_review.note: With an implementer_family the reviewer must be the other family. If it is unavailable ordinary reviews proceed with degraded_independence=true; blocking_types and high-risk reviews are blocked. task_types must equal review_mode.task_types (validated by the loader).

paseo_profiles_note: Canonical source for the Paseo agent profiles that `python3 -B -m ai_policy.paseo check|sync` manages (managed set = the keys of paseo_profiles). Each profile has at most one selector (role | level | task_types with expect). expect is [alias, effort] (effort may be null) and must be a candidate of the selector; without expect the value is the role's or level's paseo entry. A profile with no selector must be provisional and carry expect. Derived by paseo_profile_spec: provider = the model's tool, model = the exact policy id, modeId = mode_id, else review_mode[tool].modeId when every task type is a review_mode type, else hosts.paseo.default_mode_id, thinkingOptionId = effort, notes = description. provisional profiles are never named by the router and are created only by sync --include-provisional. features (plan_mode) are not managed.

root-orchestrator.description: Approved 2026-11-25: orchestrators run on Claude (Codex has no Paseo tools). Coordinates only, never edits code. Policy default was Terra high.

project-coordinator.description: Approved 2026-11-25: Claude Sonnet high (policy alternate). Do not lower effort. Creates Codex/Claude workers from these profiles; workers have no Paseo tools if Codex.

dev-l1-simple.description: LEVEL 1: rename, simple edit, docs, tests, boilerplate, pattern repeat, task coordination.

dev-l2-general.description: LEVEL 2: feature, api, frontend, bugfix, extension. Alternate: claude-sonnet-5-5 high.

dev-l3-complex.description: LEVEL 3: multi-module, state, performance, async, integration, refactor implementation, complex frontend. Alternate: gpt-6.1-terra high.

l4-critical.description: LEVEL 4: architecture major, concurrency, codebase-wide, security, data integrity, or escalation after 2 failures. Premium: max 1 concurrent, reason required. Alternate: gpt-6.2-sol high.

l5-last-resort.description: ONLY after LEVEL 4 failed twice on the same root problem. Never a starting level. Alternate: gpt-6.2-astra high.

review-codex-work.description: Independent read-only review of Codex-implemented work. Important reviews: thinking high.

review-claude-work.description: Independent review of Claude-implemented work. Instruct read-only. Alternate: gpt-6-luna high. Codex has no Paseo tools in Paseo; it reports by its final message.

lookup.description: Bounded lookup, extraction, log summary (log_summary: thinking low). No design or security.

scout.description: Provisional, no profile yet: read-only file/symbol scouting on Haiku (plan mode). Effort not set.

ui-verify.description: Provisional, no profile yet, unmeasured: UI verification on Terra high.

l5-alt-astra.description: Provisional, no profile yet: LEVEL 5 alternate (Astra) used when the failed LEVEL 4 family was Claude. Same last-resort rules as l5-last-resort.

claude.note: Described by Paseo as analysis without executing tools or edits; not verified by a write attempt.

codex.note: plan_mode is an instruction-level limit, not a tool or sandbox block. Check that git status and the diff are unchanged before and after the review.
